title: Universal Weather Node — current measurement (/api/data, MQTT <prefix>/data)
description: Values of the last completed measurement cycle. A field is present only while its sensor/function delivers a value: absent = not available (never 0 or a guess). Numbers are not rounded unless stated; round for display. Units: a field with x-unit-field takes its unit from that sibling field (or from /api/info units when the sibling is absent); x-unit is a fixed unit. x-present says when the field exists. Stability: within apiVersion 1 fields are only added, never renamed, removed or retyped.

apiVersion.description: API contract version (1). Incremented only for incompatible changes (rename, removal, type or unit change).

windDirDeg.description: Wind direction the wind blows FROM, degrees clockwise from north (0 and 360 = north). Average of the cycle (board vane: last value; wireless: vector mean).
windDirDeg.x-present: a wind source is active (sources.wind not "none") and the cycle had a valid wind sample

windSpeed.description: Mean wind speed of the cycle (MQTT: of the MQTT interval or the 10-min WMO window, see the device setting).

windGust.description: Highest 3-s gust of the cycle (wireless sensors: the highest gust the sensor reported).

windUnit.description: Unit of windSpeed, windGust, wind2.speed/gust and the rfSensors[] wind values. Imperial = mph; metric = m/s or km/h (device setting).

rainRate.description: Rain intensity: rain of the cycle scaled to one hour.
rainRate.x-present: a rain source is active (sources.rain not "none")

rain.description: Rain amount of this cycle (MQTT: of the MQTT interval).

rainSinceStart.description: Running rain total since the last restart or rain reset (monotonic; for your own differencing).

rainUnit.description: Unit of rain, rainSinceStart, rain1h … rainYear and rfSensors[].rainTotal.

temp.description: Air temperature from the selected source (sources.tempHum: board BME280 or a wireless sensor).

alarms.x-present: at least one alarm rule is active
alarms.description: Active alarm rules (Settings → Alarms, docs/alarms.md); the full list: GET /api/alarms.

name.description: Rule name (or the value key when unnamed).

astro.x-present: latitude and longitude set and the clock synced
astro.description: Sun and moon for today (local day, setting Time zone), computed on the node from latitude / longitude (no internet). Times of events that do not happen that day are left out (polar day / night, days without moonrise or moonset).

sunrise.description: Sunrise (upper limb, refraction: -0.833 deg) (UTC; absent: none on this local day).

sunset.description: Sunset (UTC; absent: none on this local day).

civilDawn.description: Begin of civil twilight (sun -6 deg) (UTC; absent: none on this local day).

civilDusk.description: End of civil twilight (UTC; absent: none on this local day).

solarNoon.description: Solar noon (sun on the meridian) (UTC; absent: none on this local day).

polar.description: Sun up all day (day) or down all day (night); absent on normal days.

dayLengthMin.description: Minutes the sun is up today.

clearSkyWm2.description: Clear-sky global radiation now (Haurwitz model) - the reference of the radiation-based sunshine detection.

moonrise.description: Moonrise (UTC; absent: none on this local day).

moonset.description: Moonset (UTC; absent: none on this local day).

moonTransit.description: Moon transit (highest point) (UTC; absent: none on this local day).

moonIlluminationPct.description: Illuminated fraction of the moon now.

moonPhase.description: Moon phase now (eight 45-degree sectors of the sun-moon elongation).

moonPhaseIndex.description: moonPhase as a number: 0 new ... 4 full ... 7 waning crescent.

tempMinToday.description: Lowest temperature since local midnight (records, see /api/records).
tempMinToday.x-present: clock synced and a temperature recorded today

gustMaxToday.x-present: clock synced and wind recorded today

tempUnit.description: Unit of temp, dewPoint, feelsLike and tempTrend1h (C → K, F → °F difference). Not present without a temperature source — use /api/info units.temp for rfSensors[] temperatures.

humidityPct.description: Relative humidity from the same source as temp.
humidityPct.x-present: temp is present and the source delivers humidity

pressureAbs.description: Station (absolute) air pressure from the selected source (sources.pressure: the BME280, or a wireless sensor with a barometer, e.g. Ecowitt WS69 pressure module, WN32P / WH25).
pressureAbs.x-present: a pressure source delivers (BME280 detected, or a wireless pressure value not older than 5 min)

pressureQnh.description: Pressure reduced to sea level (QNH) with the configured altitude — the value to display.

pressureUnit.description: Unit of pressureAbs, pressureQnh and pressureTrend3h.

items.description: Temperature of probe slot i; null = probe found at start but not readable now.

ds18b20.description: DS18B20 1-Wire probes (PCB), one entry per probe slot found at start, in ROM search order (not cable order).
ds18b20.x-present: at least one probe was found (status.bus1Present)

batteryVolt.description: LiPo battery voltage at the Heltec board (null = failed reading).

uvEnabled.description: PCB v2.0 UV input in use as the UV source (always true when present).
uvEnabled.x-present: PCB v2.0 and the board UV input is the selected UV source

uvIndexCalibrated.description: The board UV input has an enabled, confirmed calibration (only then uvIndex comes from the board).

uvSensorVolts.description: Raw UV sensor terminal voltage, cycle average (PCB v2.0 UV input).
uvSensorVolts.x-present: like uvEnabled, and a valid reading

uvIndex.description: UV index: from a wireless sensor (sources.uv = radio:…) or the calibrated board UV input.
uvIndex.x-present: a UV source delivers an index

auxAnalogV.description: PCB v2.0 AUX analog input, cycle average, scaled to the terminal voltage.
auxAnalogV.x-present: PCB v2.0, AUX analog enabled and not used by wind 2 direction

wind2.description: Second anemometer on the PCB v2.0 AUX inputs.
wind2.x-present: PCB v2.0 and wind 2 enabled (setting wind2Mode 1 or 2)

speed.description: Mean wind speed of the cycle.

dirDeg.description: Direction of the second vane, degrees from north.

auxPulses.description: PCB v2.0 AUX pulse counter: pulses in this cycle.
auxPulses.x-present: PCB v2.0, AUX pulse counter enabled and wind 2 off

auxPulsesTotal.description: AUX pulses since power-on or the last resetAuxPulses command.

heater.x-present: PCB v2.0 and heater mode on or auto

fan.description: PCB v2.0 fan output state and tacho.
fan.x-present: PCB v2.0 and fan mode on/auto or the tacho enabled

stalled.description: Fan on at 100 % for a whole cycle without tacho pulses.

victron.description: Victron VE.Direct charger/battery monitor (PCB v2.0). Each value only if the device sends it.

valid.description: A valid VE.Direct block arrived within the last 10 s; the values below only exist while true.

batteryV.x-present: valid and sent by the device

batteryA.x-present: valid and sent by the device

loadA.x-present: valid and sent (MPPT with load output)

chargeState.description: VE.Direct CS: 0 off, 2 fault, 3 bulk, 4 absorption, 5 float, 7 equalize, 245 starting up, 247 auto equalize, 252 external control.

lightLux.description: Illuminance from the selected light source (wireless sensor).

sources.description: Which sensor currently feeds each value group: "board", "radio:<8-hex-digit sensor id>" (see rfSensors[].id) or "none".
sources.x-present: wireless sensors enabled (setting rfEn); /api/info sources is always present

pressure.description: Source of pressureAbs/pressureQnh (BME280 or a wireless sensor's station pressure).

light.description: Source of lightLux and the sunshine duration.

radioBatteryLow.description: A wireless sensor that is currently a value source reports a low battery (also present as false).

dewPoint.description: Dew point from temp and humidityPct, rounded to 0.1.

vpdUnit.description: Unit of vpd (kPa in both unit systems).

feelsLike.description: Feels-like temperature: wind chill when it applies, else heat index when it applies, else temp. Rounded to 0.1.

cloudBase.description: Estimated cumulus cloud base above the station (125 m per K of temperature/dew-point spread).

windDirText.description: 16-point compass text of windDirDeg (English abbreviations; translate in your UI).

pressureTrend3h.description: QNH change over the last 3 hours, rounded to 0.01.
pressureTrend3h.x-present: BME280 and at least ~3 h of history since the start

pressureTendency.description: Barometric tendency class of pressureTrend3h (Met Office classes). Machine-readable English keys.

weatherTrend.description: Barometer rule of thumb from the 3-h tendency and QNH (no forecast model). Machine-readable English keys.

tempTrend1h.description: Temperature change over the last hour (K in metric, °F in imperial), rounded to 0.1.
tempTrend1h.x-present: temp present and at least ~1 h of history

rain1h.description: Rain in the last hour (rolling; at most one 5-min bucket short).

rain24h.description: Rain in the last 24 hours (rolling; since start if the node runs shorter).

rainToday.description: Rain since local midnight (device time zone).
rainToday.x-present: a rain source is active and the clock has been synced (NTP)

rainWeek.description: Rain this ISO week (Monday start, local time).

rainYesterday.x-present: like rainToday, and the node knows yesterday's total

lastRain.description: Time of the last rain, ISO 8601 UTC (the only absolute timestamp in this document).
lastRain.x-present: a rain source is active and rain has been recorded since the clock was synced

sunshineTodayMin.description: Sunshine duration today, estimated from illuminance ≥ 15 000 lx.
sunshineTodayMin.x-present: a light source is active and the clock has been synced

sunshineYesterdayMin.x-present: like sunshineTodayMin, and yesterday is known

warnings.description: Weather warnings computed on the node.

fog.description: Fog/dew likely: spread ≤ 1 K and humidity ≥ 95 %.

firmwareUpdate.description: A newer firmware version found by the daily update check.
firmwareUpdate.x-present: update check enabled and a newer version found

bus1Present.description: At least one DS18B20 probe was found.

sendFailCount.description: Consecutive failed LoRaWAN uplinks (0 without LoRaWAN).

pcbRev.description: PCB revision: 12 = Rev 1.2, 13 = Rev 1.3 (also the default of a board without PCB), 20 = v2.0 (also a Heltec V4 on PCB v2.0), 0 = Heltec V4 without PCB.

board.description: Heltec WiFi LoRa 32 board in effect (V4-R8 = unsupported PSRAM variant).

boardFem.description: RF front-end module detected on a V4.
boardFem.x-present: Heltec V4 with a detected front end

uvIndexCalibrated.description: PCB v2.0 UV input enabled with a valid calibration.

batteryLowLockout.description: Heater/fan held off because of a low battery.

nextCycleInSec.description: Seconds until the current measurement cycle completes and new values exist. Poll /api/data a few seconds after this.

cpuTemp.description: ESP32-S3 chip temperature (10–20 K above ambient) — enclosure health, not an air temperature.

cpuTempUnit.description: Unit of cpuTemp (follows the unit system; always present).

rfSensors.description: Every wireless sensor received since the start (at most 32; never hidden sensors; with Only my sensors only the "Mine" IDs), in table (reception) order — slot gives its number. Values in the configured units: temperatures in /api/info units.temp, wind in windUnit/units.wind, rain in rainUnit/units.rain. The same object is published per sensor on the MQTT topic <prefix>/rf/<id>.
rfSensors.x-present: wireless sensors enabled (setting rfEn); may be empty

davis.description: Davis (exclusive) receiver diagnostics — experimental, for tuning the reception on site; fields may change. Values of the transmitter itself are in rfSensors (ID DA0000ii).
davis.x-present: wireless sensor type Davis selected and wireless sensors on

running.description: Receive task active (owns the radio; LoRaWAN paused).

state.description: acquire: parked on one channel waiting for the transmitter; track: following the hop sequence; lost: too many misses, searching again; raw: raw capture on one channel.

txId.description: Transmitter ID tracked (set, or the first heard).
txId.x-present: an ID is set or was heard

freqMHz.description: Frequency listened to now, offset included.

periodMs.description: Packet period: nominal (40 + ID) / 16 s, refined by the tracking.

offsetLearnedKhz.description: Offset that received the transmitter (search scan / AFC), relative to the channel table.

syncPct.description: Share of the tracked packet slots with a valid packet.

packets.description: Valid packets of the tracked transmitter since Davis mode started.

crcErrors.description: Packets that passed the sync word with a wrong CRC.

otherPackets.description: Valid packets ignored: other transmitter ID, via a repeater, bad trailer or far off the predicted time.

resyncs.description: Times the transmitter was found again after it was lost.

lastPacketAgeSec.description: Seconds since the last valid packet.

lastRssi.description: Signal strength of the last valid packet.

lastTimingErrMs.description: Arrival of the last tracked packet minus its prediction.
lastTimingErrMs.x-present: a packet was received while tracking

rainRate.description: Rain rate reported by the ISS (from its time between bucket tips; diagnostics — the top-level rainRate is the node's own).

gust10Min.description: The ISS's own 10-minute high wind speed (message 9).

sniffer.description: Sniffer setting: every packet to the log.

rawCapture.description: Raw capture setting (parked on one channel, no hopping).

radioError.description: Last RadioLib error code of the receiver.

messages.description: Last valid packet per message type, ascending by type.

type.description: Message type (upper nibble of byte 0): 2 supercap, 3 unknown, 4 UV, 5 rain rate, 6 solar, 7 solar cell, 8 temperature, 9 gust, 10 humidity, 12 unknown, 14 rain counter.

bytes.description: Its bytes 0–5 in firmware order (as the console shows them), hex.

text.description: Decoded value as text (diagnostics; the format may change).

cycle.description: Debug: measurement cycle counter (8 bit, wraps).

uptimeH.x-present: debug mode on (/api/info device.uptimeSec is always there)

rfSensor.description: One wireless sensor. Value fields exist only for what the sensor sends.

id.description: Sensor ID, 8 upper-case hex digits (Bresser IDs change with a battery change).

batteryV.description: Battery voltage as the sensor reports it (diagnostic; batteryOk applies the model's threshold).
batteryV.x-present: Fine Offset sensors that send a voltage (WH51, WN34 / WN38, WH40, WN20, WS80 / WS90 ...)

ecowittId.description: The ID as the Ecowitt app / console shows it (Fine Offset sensors: the low 24 bits, WH31 / WH25 / WH32 the 8-bit ID); accepted in the Mine / Hidden lists.

slot.description: Wireless sensor number 1–32: the "Mine" sensors first in list order, then the other received sensors in reception order (table position). Slots 1–4 are the Wireless 1–4 choices of the value-source settings; Loxone names rf<slot>_….
slot.x-present: always, except beyond number 32 (many listed but not received IDs plus many others)

mine.description: The sensor is in the "Mine" list (settings star): numbered first, gets a Home Assistant device. Hidden sensors never appear here.

type.description: Bresser sensor type number: 0/1/12/13 weather station, 2 thermo-hygro, 3 pool thermometer, 4 soil, 5 leakage, 8 air quality PM, 9 rain gauge or lightning, 10 CO2, 11 HCHO/VOC. Fine Offset and IT+ sensors are mapped to the same numbers; the Fine Offset temperature probes WN34 and WN38 (black globe) also use 3, the WN35 leaf wetness sensor 4 (like the WH51/WH52 soil sensors) — tell them apart by model.

protocol.description: Radio protocol it was received with.

model.description: Fine Offset model, e.g. WS90, WS85, WS80, WS69, WH65, WH24, WH31, WH31B, WH40, WN20, WN34, WN38, WH51, WH57, WS68, WN32 (WH32 outdoor family), WN32P (WH25 / WH32B indoor family), WN35, WH41, WH0290, WH43, WH45, WH46, WH52, WH55; Davis: "Vantage Pro2" or "Vantage Vue" (the station setting, not detected).

channel.description: Channel switch of a WH31 (1–8) or WH55 (1–4); Davis: transmitter ID 1–8.

rssi.description: Signal strength of the last packet.

ageSec.description: Seconds since the last packet of this sensor.

batteryOk.description: Battery state reported by the sensor (false = low).

windSpeed.description: Wind mean speed of the last packet.

windGust.description: Wind gust of the last packet.

windDirDeg.description: Wind direction of the last packet.

rainTotal.description: The sensor's own rain counter since its last battery change / reset (not a total of this node; shown as "counter") — use rainToday or the top-level rain values for display.

soilMoistureAd.description: Raw AD value of the WH51 moisture probe (9 bit) - for the two-point calibration (soilMoisturePct then uses it).

rainToday.description: Rain since local midnight from this sensor's counter increments (counter resets handled like the main rain path; RAM only: since the node started if that was today).
rainToday.x-present: the sensor sends rain and the clock is synced

rain1h.description: Rain of the last hour (six 10-minute buckets) from this sensor's counter increments.

solarWm2.description: Solar radiation (Davis solar radiation sensor); lightLux carries it converted with 126.7 lx per W/m² (an approximation).

supercapV.description: Super-capacitor voltage, rounded to 0.1 (WS85/WS90; Davis Vue: raw/300, scaling not verified).
supercapV.x-present: WS85, WS90, Davis transmitters that send it (Vue)

lightningCount.description: The sensor's raw strike counter (8 bit, wraps) - diagnostic; use lightningToday / lightning1h.

lightningToday.description: Strikes since local midnight from the counter's increments (the first packet after a start is the baseline; a jump > 50 in one packet = counter reset, not counted).
lightningToday.x-present: lightning sensor and the clock synced

lastLightning.description: Time of the packet with the last counted strike (UTC).
lastLightning.x-present: a strike was counted since the node started (clock synced)

lightningDistKm.x-present: lightning sensor with a detected storm

pressure.description: Station pressure measured by the sensor (not reduced to sea level), latest packet; rounded to 0.1 hPa / 0.01 inHg. Also usable as the node's pressure source (sources.pressure), then pressureAbs = this value and pressureQnh reduced with the configured altitude.
pressure.x-present: Fine Offset WN32P / WH25 / WH32B indoor sensor, WS69 with pressure module

pm25.x-present: Fine Offset air quality sensor (WH41, WH0290, WH43, WH45, WH46)

pm10.x-present: Fine Offset air quality sensor (WH41, WH0290, WH43, WH45, WH46)

pm10Estimated.description: true: pm10 is not measured but derived from PM2.5 by the sensor's particle counter (Honeywell HPM; the Ecowitt consoles do not show it).

externalPower.description: The air quality sensor reports USB power (battery level 6).
externalPower.x-present: air quality sensor powered via USB

leak.description: Water leak alarm of the sensor (true = water detected).

leakHighSensitivity.description: Sensitivity switch of the leak sensor (true = high).

leakRaw.description: Raw measurement of the leak sensor (lower = wetter; about 650-730 dry in the published captures).

leafWetnessPct.x-present: Fine Offset WN35 leaf wetness sensor

conductivityUsCm.description: Soil electrical conductivity (EC); empirical scaling from the published analysis (within about 1 %).

stale.description: Value groups not received for more than 5 minutes (shown values are old; the node no longer uses them).
stale.x-present: at least one value is stale
